title: Harness Definition
description: A harness definition describes one agent platform (harness) — its identity, installation paths, macros, sidecars, and optional manifest template. Matches HarnessDefinition in src/registry/types.rs. Unknown fields are rejected.

id.description: Canonical harness identifier (e.g., claude, codex, opencode)

name.description: Human-readable display name (e.g., Claude Code, Codex CLI)

version.description: Optional version string of this harness definition. The loader accepts any string.

capabilities.description: Feature flags and length caps for this harness

supports_subagent.description: Whether the harness supports sub-agent invocation

requires_sidecar.description: Whether the harness requires sidecar files

requires_manifest.description: Whether the harness requires a manifest file

supports_allowed_tools.description: Whether allowed-tools is supported in skill config

supports_disable_model_invocation.description: Whether disable-model-invocation is supported in skill config

supports_user_invocable_flag.description: Whether user-invocable is supported in skill config

paths.description: Output path configuration for this harness

project_scope_path.description: Directory for project-scoped skill output relative to project root (e.g., .claude/skills)

skill_filename.description: Filename for the rendered skill file (e.g., SKILL.md)

manifest_scope_path.description: Directory for manifest output (e.g., .claude). Omit if the harness has no manifest system.

manifest_filename.description: Filename for the manifest file (e.g., plugin.json). Omit if the harness has no manifest system.

macros.description: Named macros available to templates as harness.<name>. Each value is either an inline string or an object with a content string. Omission defaults to an empty map. Keys are any string.

oneOf.description: Function-like macro. The loader reads content and ignores other keys.

sidecars.description: Sidecar file templates generated alongside each skill (zero or more). Omission defaults to an empty list.

template.description: Jinja2 template for the sidecar content

output_dir.description: Optional subdirectory within the skill output directory

manifest.description: Optional manifest definition. The loader reads only the template string.

template.description: Jinja2 template for the manifest content

skill_ref_pattern.description: Pattern for referencing skills in this harness (e.g., /{name}). {name} is replaced at runtime.
